citation.description: Seven tests assert SENTINEL not in emitted log records; TokenRedactingFilter in config.py scrubs token= from uvicorn.access log args; _request_token() in app.py prefers X-Rebar-Token header over query param

criteria.criterion: The webhook/rerun secret no longer appears in any log record the receiver emits, proven by a test that asserts on the emitted log line with a sentinel value and is verified RED by reverting the fix.

citation.description: TOKEN_HEADER constant (lines 57-66) and _request_token() docstring (lines 93-104) explain why header is preferred and explicitly warn against reintroducing query-string form. config.py lines 165-172 explain the redaction filter as belt-and-suspenders backstop.

criteria.criterion: The mechanism is stated in the code where the choice is made (header vs redaction filter), including WHY — so a future change does not reintroduce the query-string form as a convenience.

citation.description: Recipe uses -H 'X-Rebar-Token: $TOKEN' (no URL token). Lines 75-84 explicitly say NEVER put the token in the URL and include a ROTATION note stating any URL-passed token must be treated as compromised and rotated.

criteria.criterion: infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md's /rerun recipe no longer instructs the operator to put the token in a URL, and carries a note that the previous token must be treated as compromised and rotated.

citation.description: TokenRedactingFilter.filter() returns True (passes record through), only scrubs token= values. Tests at test_review_bot_token_redaction.py lines 59-61 assert /rerun, change=1323, and 202 still appear in the message after redaction.

criteria.criterion: The access log still records route and status for both endpoints (the observability greps and debugging value are not sacrificed to fix this).

citation.description: Rotation ticket 43ea-3d5a-078f-4fe3 ('Rotate compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN') exists and carries an operator attestation comment dated 2026-08-04 stating all affected credentials were rotated and leaked material purged. The comment references commit 4e8c83c833, Gerrit change 1384 (MERGED), and explicitly states the code prerequisite is satisfied. The 66af ticket's AC5 comment also records this with the same date and ticket reference.

criteria.criterion: ROTATION IS TRACKED SEPARATELY AND EXPLICITLY: the currently-logged token is rotated, and that rotation is recorded as done rather than assumed, since the code fix does not un-leak what is already in journald.
